content: On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her throughout her childhood. As reported earlier by The Guardian, the judge wrote that over the past year, Ann had failed to appear for an independent medical examination or meet other deadlines despite warnings that it would result in the case being dismissed. When the case was filed last year, a statement shared by Sam Altman, his mother, and his brothers said, “Annie has made deeply hurtful and entirely untrue claims about our family, and especially Sam… All of these claims are utterly untrue. This situation causes immense pain to our entire family.” Bluestone granted Sam Altman’s motion to dismiss the case with prejudice, meaning it can’t be refiled in that court, while denying Sam’s request for attorney fees and costs. Santos Perez, a lawyer who had represented Ann until withdrawing this month, told The Guardian in a statement that “I am no longer authorized to comment on this case but I continue to believe in Annie.” [Media: https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28825645-ann-altman-sam-altman-lawsuit-granting-motion-to-dismiss/]

chineseContent: 周二，美国地区法官 Zachary Bluestone 驳回了 Ann Altman 去年提起的诉讼，指控她的兄弟、OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 在她的整个童年时期对她进行了性虐待。正如《卫报》早些时候报道的那样，法官写道，在过去的一年里，安未能出席独立体检或遵守其他最后期限，尽管警告称这将导致案件被驳回。去年立案时，山姆·奥尔特曼、他的母亲和兄弟们共同发表的一份声明称，“安妮对我们的家庭，尤其是山姆，做出了非常伤人且完全不实的指控……所有这些指控都是完全不真实的。这种情况给我们整个家庭带来了巨大的痛苦。” Bluestone 批准了 Sam Altman 的有偏见驳回案件的动议，这意味着该案件不能在该法院重新提交，同时拒绝了 Sam 支付律师费和费用的请求。桑托斯·佩雷斯（Santos Perez）是安的代理律师，本月退出，他在一份声明中告诉《卫报》，“我不再被授权对此案发表评论，但我仍然相信安妮。” [媒体：https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28825645-ann-altman-sam-altman-lawsuit-granting-motion-to-dismiss/]
